AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Soldier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: A persona matrix designed for rapid combat deployment. Comes pre-loaded with foundational melee skills, firearms proficiency, and weapon maintenance protocols.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Artist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Designed for the mass production of artworks. Imprinted with human-defined aesthetic standards and comprehensive fabrication knowledge.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Aide
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Built primarily to assist others, this matrix's knowledge base spans nearly all known fields—pushing the storage capacity of a persona matrix to its absolute limit.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Medical Assistant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Contains extensive physiological data calibrated for humans, enabling it to provide basic medical aid and emergency care.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Technician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Designed for manual tasks in diverse environments. Loaded with multi-disciplinary mechanical operation knowledge, capable of independently completing fabrication tasks without mechanical support.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Constable
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Created for conflict mediation between individuals, with contingency protocols for violent scenarios. Includes friendly social interaction modules and proficiency with most melee weapons.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Adjutant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Designed to provide tactical advice and decision-making guidance. Contains leadership protocols and basic firearms knowledge.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Technical Officer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Optimized for coordinating production workflows. Loaded with rich theoretical knowledge and practical records, capable of independently analyzing and adjusting production strategies.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Research Assistant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Designed to support scientific research. Combines multidisciplinary knowledge with enhanced computational and logical reasoning capabilities.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Guard
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Created for general protective duties. Excels in close-quarters combat and situational awareness, serving equally well as a social escort in formal settings.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Maid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Designed for personal attendant duties. Includes standard cleaning and culinary knowledge, along with intimate care protocols—and certain unspoken specialties. The predefined personality attributes also occupy significant matrix capacity.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Miner
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Built for large-scale mining operations. Contains both equipment operation knowledge and autonomous mining protocols for resource-scarce environments.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Architect
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Capable of simultaneous architectural planning and construction. Includes fundamental material science knowledge, enabling adaptation to resource-poor or exotic material environments.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Persona Matrix - Farmer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Designed for crop cultivation and livestock management on an industrial scale. Contains comprehensive biological knowledge and environmental assessment protocols.
